decisions.reason: Building on the established offer and aimed at through-contacts for semiconductor wafers, it remains a strategically aligned, low-cost option with unresolved upside.
Carrier wafers fit the firm's existing capabilities and thin-wafer handling direction, so keeping this low-cost option is consistent with real options logic.
As a flagship copper interposer glass wafer, it is central to the firm's stated direction and merits continued investment while packaging demand uncertainty resolves.
The off-the-shelf brand is close to the existing offer and a strategic focus, making it a valuable option with low keeping costs.
Distant from the established offer and without evidence of traction, it is a more costly, uncertain option that should be abandoned to free resources for closer strategic options.
